tokenization gains flow to existing financial infrastructure

institutional participation.

76749.subject: Robinhood’s Q2 2026: a 44% EPS beat, a $106M gain that’s already gone & why HOOD stock fell anyway 🏹📉; Revolut o…
76749.body:
View this post on the web at https://linas.substack.com/p/fintechpulse1107

Hey Everyone,
Good morning & happy Friday! Earnings time 🤑 Stock trading giant Robinhood $HOOD  just delivered the blowout quarter everyone wanted, and the stock fell anyway.
Revenues rose 32% year-over-year to a record $1.31B, and diluted EPS of $0.62 crushed the $0.41-0.43 consensus by 44-51%. Net deposits hit a record $21.7B, platform assets a record $369B, Gold subscribers a record 4.8M, and management lowered the full-year expense guide while calling the business “firing on all cylinders.” Not too shabby!
And still the stock dropped 3.15% on the day and another 2.69% the next morning to $87.42 - 24% below its July 15 close & 43% below its 52-week high 🤷‍♂️
But the most important number of the quarter wasn’t the beat, and it wasn’t the selloff either. It was $4 billion - the pace of new customer deposits in July, disclosed on the earnings call. Some context here: net deposits are the metric management itself calls the engine of the business, because deposits become platform assets, and assets become trading, margin lending and Gold subscriptions. Robinhood targets roughly 20% annual growth on this line, and Q2 delivered 28%. Put simply, the record quarter ended the moment the quarter did.
